Welcome to Laufer Group

We are the premier provider of ground services in Israel. Established in 1975 and a proud subsidiary of the Maman Group, Laufer Group stands at the forefront of aviation services, combining the strengths of Laufer GHI to offer unmatched ground handling, VIP services, and private flight solutions. 

Serving over 6 million passengers and facilitating 26,000 flights annually across Ben Gurion and Ramon Airports, we are dedicated to excellence and personalized service. Whether you’re an international airline or a discerning traveler seeking the finest in aviation services, Laufer Group is your trusted partner, ensuring a seamless and luxurious experience every time you take to the skies.

aboutPage.bodyText:
Leading with Excellence: The Laufer Group Story

50 years of Quality, Safety, and Professionalism

Discover Laufer Group

Welcome to Laufer Group, where a legacy of excellence since 1975 has shaped us into Israel’s leading aviation services provider. As a key part of the Maman Group, we offer an unparalleled combination of ground handling, VIP, and private flight services.  Our focus on personalized attention, safety, and superior service has made us the trusted choice for global airlines and discerning travelers, handling over 6 million passengers and 26,000 flights annually.

Service Beyond the Basics

We understand that every client has unique needs.  It’s more than just our core handling services – we tailor our approach,  finding creative solutions to any challenge.  This flexibility and adaptability set us apart.

The Power of People

Behind our success, our professionalism, and our commitment to service are 800 skilled employees. Their dedication fuels our growth.  We also have a passionate and experienced management team driving innovation and ensuring Laufer consistently exceeds expectations.


Service Beyond the Basics

We understand that every client has unique needs.  It’s more than just our core handling services – we tailor our approach,  finding creative solutions to any challenge.  This flexibility and adaptability set us apart.

Envisioning Tomorrow’s Customer Needs, Today

Our goal is to set the industry standard for service excellence and technological innovation. We invest in our people, embrace change, and obsess over the details. This allows Laufer Group to anticipate and exceed the evolving requirements of our clients and the global aviation community.

Commitment to Excellence

Laufer proudly adheres to the highest international standards. Our memberships in the International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the IATA Ground Handling Council (IGHC) signal our unwavering focus on quality, safety, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. In a constantly changing industry, Laufer Group is driven to deliver forward-thinking solutions and relentless excellence.

our values

LAUFER AVIATION-GHI HAS ESTABLISHED SIX FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES THAT OUTLINE OUR COMPANY VALUES.
THE COMPANY INSTILLS THESE VALUES IN ITS EMPLOYEES, THEY FORM THE BASIS OF THE QUALITY SERVICE PROVIDED TO ITS CUSTOMERS.

Leadership

We work to be unique and provide above and beyond service to our employees and customers so that we are the first and best choice for them.

Belonging

Our employees and customers are key to the company’s success. We act fairly and while providing personal treatment, to create commitment, care, identification and “unique pride”

Transparency

We operate with openness, mutual respect, honesty and responsibility while constantly working to achieve our goals and to the satisfaction of our employees and customers

Strength

Together, in teamwork, we act as one body in constant action for a common goal, to achieve the company’s goals and maintain its strength

Innovation

We encourage creative and inquisitive thinking while cross-fertilizing and using supporting tools and advanced systems, to improve existing areas of activity and to create new and diverse areas

Experience

The totality of activities, human capital and corporate culture will constitute for our employees and customers: home, family, friends!
